exercises.title: Title triage
exercises.intro: Practice data for Maple Run's title commitment, not part of RD-RES-01. Decide each item: accept it, cure it at closing, or hold closing until it is cleared (CORE-CLS-01, -06).

items.text: Schedule B-II: 2026 second-half taxes, not yet due
items.why: A standard exception. The borrower pays the taxes when due (worked example 3).

items.text: Schedule B-II: rear-lot 10-foot utility easement; the survey shows no building on it
items.why: The survey confirms the easement is clear, so it can stay as an exception.

items.text: Schedule B-II: mechanic's lien by the prior owner's roofer, $6,200
items.why: It could prime our lien. It must be released or bonded before closing (CORE-CLS-01).

items.text: Schedule B-II: a recorded $12,400 mechanic's lien
items.why: Any lien that could prime ours must go before closing (CORE-CLS-01; quiz A4).
Move it to Schedule B-I: pay it off from sale proceeds and record a release. It stays ahead of our mortgage until released.

items.text: Schedule A shows the lender's policy amount as $240,000, the day-one advance
items.why: The policy must insure the full $340,000 commitment, including the rehab holdback (CORE-CLS-06). Amend Schedule A.

items.text: The commitment has no ALTA 32-series endorsement, though this is a rehab loan with draws
items.why: Rehab loans add an ALTA 32-series endorsement, with an ALTA 33 date-down at each draw (CORE-CLS-06; T2).

exercises.title: The coinsurance trap
exercises.intro: Coinsurance pays (carried ÷ required) × loss − deductible, where required = clause % × replacement cost (F-CORE-37). Insurance-to-value is cover ÷ replacement cost and must be at least 100% (F-CORE-34, CORE-INS-01).

calculator.task: What-if values for Birchwood (worked example 4). What does the insurer pay? How much is the coinsurance penalty against $475,000? ITV is $4,400,000 ÷ $5,200,000 = 84.6%. Then raise the limit to $5,200,000: what changes?

exercises.title: Which guaranties?
exercises.intro: Recourse depends on family, size and LTV. Future funding adds a completion guaranty, and MF and COM add an environmental indemnity (CORE-DOC-01 to -03).

res_ff.q: Is there future funding, such as a rehab holdback?

mf_size.q: Is the bridge commitment $2,000,000 or more?

mf_big_ff.q: Is there future funding, such as capex?

mf_small_ff.q: Is there future funding, such as capex?

com_ltv.q: Is the day-one LTV, on the lower of price and appraisal, 60% or below?

com_low_ff.q: Is there future funding, such as capex or TI/LC?

com_high_ff.q: Is there future funding, such as capex or TI/LC?

end_res_cg.result: Full-recourse guaranty, plus a completion guaranty.
end_res_cg.explain: Every residential loan is full recourse (CORE-DOC-01, RES-GEN-07). Future funding adds a completion guaranty (CORE-DOC-03). No environmental indemnity for residential.

end_res.explain: Every residential loan is full recourse, at any size or LTV (CORE-DOC-01, RES-GEN-07).

end_full_cg.result: Full-recourse guaranty, completion guaranty and environmental indemnity.
end_full_cg.explain: A multifamily bridge under $2,000,000 is full recourse (MF-BR-12). Future funding adds a completion guaranty; MF adds an environmental indemnity (CORE-DOC-03).

end_full.explain: A multifamily bridge under $2,000,000 is full recourse (MF-BR-12). Every MF loan adds an environmental indemnity (CORE-DOC-03).

end_nr_cg.result: Non-recourse carve-out guaranty, completion guaranty and environmental indemnity.
end_nr_cg.explain: This size or LTV qualifies for non-recourse with carve-outs (MF-BR-12 or COM-BR-07; CORE-DOC-02). Future funding adds a completion guaranty, plus the environmental indemnity (CORE-DOC-03).

end_nr.result: Non-recourse carve-out guaranty and environmental indemnity.
end_nr.explain: This size or LTV qualifies for non-recourse with carve-outs (MF-BR-12 or COM-BR-07; CORE-DOC-02). MF and COM add an environmental indemnity (CORE-DOC-03).

end_burn_cg.result: Full guarantee that burns off at stabilization, completion guaranty and environmental indemnity.
end_burn_cg.explain: Above 60% LTV, a commercial bridge needs a full guarantee that burns off (COM-BR-07). Future funding adds a completion guaranty, plus the environmental indemnity (CORE-DOC-03).

end_burn.result: Full guarantee that burns off at stabilization, and environmental indemnity.
end_burn.explain: Above 60% LTV, a commercial bridge needs a full guarantee that burns off (COM-BR-07). COM adds an environmental indemnity (CORE-DOC-03).
